newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Foreigners buy two pct Tranquilidade.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners buy two pct Tranquilidade.

text.p: Foreign institutional investors bought two percent of the capital of Portuguese insurer Tranquilidade on Lisbon bourse, dealers said.
"The buyer was a foreign broker who submitted buy orders from two or three foreign institutional investors," said one dealer linked to the operation.
The investors acquired 388,000 shares in Tranquilidade.
Analysts said Grupo Espirito Santo had reduced its stake in Tranquilidade.
It was not immediately possible to identify the purchasers of the Tranquilidade shares.
Tranquilidade shares stood unchanged at 3,280 escudos in volume of 397,848 shares at 1342 GMT.
